notes: Final 1.5B shared generator: Bloom transformation + QA + summarization.
Bloom transformation uses data/rewrite dataset/bloomshift_final_candidate only.
The 0.5B Bloom classification dataset is excluded.
8192 tokens are used because empirical tokenization showed that 4096 still leaves a small number of long QA/summarization prompts without an assistant target after truncation.
Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct supports a 32768-token context window; 8192 is the selected SFT limit for this experiment.
Do not tune hyperparameters after inspecting the held-out test split.
